title: Microsoft's Data Center Plans Face Big Costs
snippet: Microsoft plans to more than triple its data center capacity to help overcome a computing shortage that has forced it to turn away some AI and cloud business. Bloomberg's Brody Ford joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oracle’s Cloud Growth; Debate Around AI Risks
snippet: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Oracle's latest results and how they are helping ease concerns around the company's massive AI infrastructure buildout. Plus, the debate around AI's societal risks and the backlash against the global data center build-out grow louder. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Balancing AI Risks With the Race to Stay Ahead of China
snippet: As debate intensifies over the risks of advanced AI and the rapid expansion of data centers, Eclipse CEO Lior Susan venture argues the industry needs collaboration rather than a retreat to avoid ceding the US's technological lead over China. He also says the tech industry needs to do a better job explaining the benefits of data centers to local communities and how physical AI could become a major driver of US economic growth. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Sued Over Training Data for Its AI and Face-Recognition Systems
